changelog: Every act boss is now a COMMANDER IN THE FIELD, not a building — it walks, fights, brings its own deck, commands in its own style, and carries a doctrine that buffs its whole force. The Quartermaster's troops muster tougher; the Berserker's warband hits +2 in close quarters; everything the Iron Marshal commands takes 1 less damage; the Bombardier's ordnance hits +3 and it now HOLDS a gunline instead of walking into range; the Saboteur and Alchemist stop assaulting entirely — they work around your flanks with a sniper, take the high ground, poison the ground with gas, and slip curses straight into your HAND (including a new one, Sapped Foundations, that chews on your HQ). Aggressive bosses now contest nodes and outposts and go for your BASE ahead of your outbuildings. Enemy snipers spend their shot on your most dangerous unit, not the nearest one. Dug-in enemies push turrets toward you to stop your advance and can finally play fire, gas and EMP cards at all. NOMAD REWORKED around true momentum: keep every unit moving — troops, the Command Vehicle, walkers, anything — and your trajectory climbs every single turn, with no ceiling, discharging Break Camp over and over. Stall one unit and it halves. The Nomad also musters a second Attack Dog. All three starter decks trimmed to 10 cards. Fixes: blast animations now play BEFORE the damage they cause (called-in strikes looked backwards), and a pathfinding fix cuts battle processing by about a quarter — plus the storm and hit effects no longer re-blur every frame, which should run noticeably cooler on a phone.
